title: FlightPlan Authority Provenance
description: Authority provenance chain for FlightPlan receipts. Defines the authority relationship between observation source, decision owner, consumer, and transformation chain. Includes contract lineage for governance traceability.

decisionOwner.description: The component that owns the decision semantics (e.g., 'flightplan-mcp').

observationSource.description: The component that produced the observation (e.g., 'flightplan-mcp', 'openwork').

localTransforms.description: Ordered chain of local transformations applied by the consumer.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the work profile schema (e.g., 'work-profile-v1').
